notes: The in-app Generation setup guide detects the connected generation device, selects compatible model variants where available, and reuses existing files. NVIDIA provides the complete curated route, Apple Metal uses a compatible subset, and AMD ROCm is experimental with an existing compatible ComfyUI/PyTorch environment. Users may override recommendations after reviewing difficulty warnings.

features.variant: Krea 2 FP8 or native INT8 ConvRot with dynamic VRAM offloading + SeedVR2 FP8

features.label: Klein 4B Edit + Outpaint
features.variant: Klein 4B FP8 with system-RAM offload; configured GGUF files use the GGUF loader

features.variant: Klein 9B FP8; configured GGUF files use the GGUF loader

features.label: MiniMax H3 Video
features.variant: Official pruned INT8 ConvRot FL2VA diffusion model + NVFP4 AWQ Qwen3-VL encoder with dynamic offload; includes T2V, I2V, first/last frames, and native stereo audio

hardware.unsupportedReason: The curated MiniMax H3 workflow uses NVIDIA NVFP4/AWQ and INT8 ConvRot kernels and is not currently compatible with Apple Metal or AMD ROCm.

features.label: MiniMax H3 Reference-to-Video
features.variant: Optional official pruned INT8 ConvRot Ref2VA diffusion model; downloaded separately from the standard H3 workflow

hardware.unsupportedReason: The curated MiniMax H3 Reference-to-Video workflow uses NVIDIA NVFP4/AWQ and INT8 ConvRot kernels and is not currently compatible with Apple Metal or AMD ROCm.

features.label: LTX Edit Anything

features.label: 10Eros DMD
features.variant: 10Eros FP8 mixed; 8 GB is an experimental tier with aggressive offload

features.label: Wan 2.2 Video

features.label: SCAIL 2 Motion Transfer

hardware.unsupportedReason: SCAIL 2 currently uses a curated FP8 Wan model that Apple Metal cannot execute.
